xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5184: Composer keeps sent text and blocks a second send until the server acknowledges

plan.title: Composer keeps sent text and blocks a second send until the server acknowledges
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: After Send, the conversation composer keeps the sent text until the server acknowledges the POST (up to the 120 s client bound) and refuses a second Send until then, because ComposerFooter sets the per-conversation sending flag for every send and clears the editor only after the POST resolves. The operator cannot send a quick follow-up, and the text shows twice: in the Sending bubble and in the box.
narratives.Proposal: Clear the editor, its conv-draft localStorage key, attachments and citations synchronously at prompt Send, right after the optimistic bubble is added, and post the prompt through a new per-conversation send queue (lib/composerSendQueue.ts) that runs POSTs one at a time in Send order. Prompt sends stop setting the sending flag, so the composer stays editable. The POST and its outcome move to components/chat/queuedPromptSend.ts. Held-message resends and outbox retries share the queue, a retry after a proven non-delivery uses a fresh clientMessageId, a queued prompt behind a held bubble is held too, and a queued bubble restarts its stall clock when its POST starts. /pan commands, held-kickoff starts and limit-reset schedules keep today's blocking behavior.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No server change: message routes, the receipts cache and the 120 s client request bound stay as they are.
- /pan commands, held-kickoff Send and limit-reset schedule Send must keep blocking the composer and keep their text until their round trip succeeds; they do not use the send queue.
- A failed prompt send must not put its text back into the composer (PAN-2083); it lives only in the outbox.
- No change to SubagentComposer, TellComposer, HomeComposer or any other composer.
- No reload durability for queued sends and no cancel control for a queued send.
- No allowlist row in scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt; ComposerFooter.tsx stays at or under 1000 lines.
- No edits to the external OKF knowledge bundle (../overdeck-knowledge).
- No change to how releaseHeldMessages resends: it already drops deliverAs and agentId, so a steer held behind a held bubble is released as a plain send.

autoDecisions.summary: Put the queue in a new module lib/composerSendQueue.ts instead of inside composerStore.ts
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names composerStore.ts only as an example; a standalone module is unit-testable alone and keeps ComposerFooter.tsx under the 1000-line file-size ceiling.

autoDecisions.summary: /pan commands bypass the queue and keep blocking the composer
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says commands keep their current behavior; they are answered by the dashboard control plane and never reach the agent transcript, so prompt ordering does not apply.

autoDecisions.summary: Steer sends (Ctrl/Cmd+Enter) are queued like any prompt
autoDecisions.rationale: Requirement 2 says messages for one conversation reach the agent in Send order; a steer that overtakes an in-flight prompt would break that.

autoDecisions.summary: Held-message resends and outbox retries also go through the queue, and a queued prompt behind a held bubble is held without a POST
autoDecisions.rationale: Without this, a permission-prompt hold or a retry lets a later message reach the agent before an earlier one, which requirement 2 forbids.

autoDecisions.summary: A queued bubble restarts its createdAt when its POST starts
autoDecisions.rationale: useComposerEchoes counts TURN_STALL_MS from createdAt; queue wait plus a slow POST could otherwise move a just-delivered message to the outbox as Not found in transcript.

autoDecisions.summary: Draft helpers move to lib/composerDraft.ts and Send calls an explicit clearDraft
autoDecisions.rationale: Requirement 5 asks for removal at send time; the debounce plus pagehide flush misses a crash inside 300 ms, and every ComposerFooter test mocks ComposerPromptEditor, so a helper there could not be tested against real localStorage.

autoDecisions.summary: An outbox Retry of a deliveryUnknown:false failure sends a fresh clientMessageId
autoDecisions.rationale: The server receipts cache replays a cached 409 for the old id, so Retry of input-target-not-main would always fail; once failed text lives only in the outbox, Retry must actually resend, and a proven non-delivery cannot duplicate.

autoDecisions.summary: Editor focus happens once at Send, never when a queued POST settles
autoDecisions.rationale: The editor no longer goes read-only, so the old refocus is not needed, and a late focus could pull the cursor away from wherever the operator is working.
